caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden bed with a light-colored mattress and bedsheet. The bed features a prominent headboard and footboard, both with an outward-curving, scroll-like design at the tops and thick, sturdy side panels. The wood grain is illustrated in varying shades of brown, giving depth and texture to the entire frame. The side rails of the bed are curved in the middle with a carved decorative element at the center of the side, and the bed stands on four short, bun-shaped legs that each have small caster wheels beneath them. The mattress and bedsheet are depicted in pale, off-white tones, with slight shading to indicate contour and depth. The background is plain and neutral, with a faded beige color.
title: Bed Double
